verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for an analytics and feature-flag platform with SDKs and a CLI, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no setting to disable telemetry, usage tracking, or SDK event logging. It only shows that exposure events are logged automatically and that custom events are collected for analytics.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
